_doc: REPLACEABLE HEAD REGION (HAIR strand v2/hair/, FACE strand v2/face2/ own it). In blockout/<V>.txt the codes H,B,W,F,e (hair, bun, bow, face, eyes) above the chin line are placeholders. Body sections (neck row 28 down) are fixed by the template. Rows are 64-cell rows, soles on row 61 (sole line 62), crown 14.

latitude.rule: crown row may rise to 13 (h 15) or chin line drop to 29 (then shoulder line 30, neck 1 row). Head width (hair mass at temple/cheek level) <= 16 px (cols 24-39/40). Big anime eyes: fine inside this; keep eye centre <= 0.66 of head height down.

hair_envelope.note: Free hair silhouette zone. Hair below the chin line is allowed only BEHIND the body (it must not widen shoulders >12 px or hide the neck gap / waist pinch in S,SE); ponytails/side locks may hang to row 41 (hem) outside the body only if <=2 px wide, so arms/waist still read.
